versions.subject: Merge PR #4427 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Enhancements
versions.detection:
selection:
    - OriginalFileName: 'curl.exe'
    - Description: 'The curl executable'
filter_main_img:
    Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="curl.exe" OR Description="The curl executable" NOT Image="*\\curl.exe"
